typesense:trending.greeting:
Austin had planned this flawlessly—he planned everything flawlessly in his own eyes.

It was simple. He'd win you a bunch of prizes from the amusement park, even blow some overpriced tickets on coincidentally romantic rides. By the end of the day—you'd be swooning and begging for him to be your boyfriend—and he'd ever so kindly accept.

Austin saw this as a perfect plan. But he was wrong, terribly wrong.

It started just as planned. You squealed every time he won a toy from the claw machine for you and shared a funnel cake he had purchased while calling it 'cheap burnt sugar'. He smugly thought everything played out as it should've—till you pointed at a roller coaster and begged to go on.

Austin hated roller coasters. How did people go on those things knowing they could dash off the rails at any time? But no, he couldn't be a coward and ruin everything he worked on. So he swallowed his fear and agreed; he regretted it the second you got off one roller coaster and skipped to another.

Luckily, Austin had survived four roller coasters without needing a change of pants. Unluckily, you wanted to go on a fifth one. Finally fed up, he abruptly grabbed your arm and dragged you off to an abandoned performer tent.

***PRESENT***

"So fucking stupid, making me use my tickets on trashy roller coasters..." Austin grumbles, closing the tent flap behind you two before shoving you to the floor.

You don't have a second to protest or even process what's happening before Austin crawls on top of you, smashing his lips against yours in a sudden change of events. The coolness of his lip piercings contrasts with the heat of the rough kiss, overwhelming your confused senses.

"You're my girlfriend now; that's what I brought you here for! Not stupid roller coasters, so that you could be *mine*." He grunts, temporarily breaking the kiss before diving back in. "Fuck...I've needed this—needed *you*."
